flooring.label: LifeProof Rigid Core LVP
flooring.product: LifeProof Rigid Core Luxury Vinyl Plank

floor-lvp.title: Luxury vinyl plank
floor-lvp.note: DIY-friendly floating floor. Acclimate 48 hrs; leave a perimeter expansion gap.

floor-engineered.title: Engineered hardwood
floor-engineered.note: Click/float is DIY-friendly; glue-down on concrete is harder. Acclimate 3-5 days; 1/2 in. expansion gap.

floor-hardwood.title: Solid hardwood
floor-hardwood.note: Professional install recommended. Nailer on a wood subfloor; acclimate; straight first row; expansion gaps.

floor-tile.title: Floor tile
floor-tile.note: Pro recommended for stone / large-format. Seal natural stone; wait 24 hrs before walking.

floor-concrete.title: Stained / polished concrete floor
floor-concrete.note: Pro recommended for mechanical polishing. Concrete must be cured ~1 month; test porosity.

paint.title: Interior paint
paint.note: Ceiling, then walls, then trim. Two coats; 2-4 hrs between.

cabinets.title: Kitchen cabinets
cabinets.note: Hang uppers first off a level ledger; get a helper.

counter-stone.title: Stone / quartz countertop
machinery: Angle grinder w/ wet diamond blade
counter-stone.note: Professional install recommended - slabs are very heavy and need precise templating, seaming and lifting gear.

counter-concrete.title: Concrete countertop
counter-concrete.note: Advanced, multi-day project (cast-in-place or pre-cast); slabs are heavy - 2-4 people to move.

counter-butcherblock.title: Butcher block countertop
counter-butcherblock.note: Acclimate 72 hrs; finish before and after install.

backsplash-tile.title: Tile backsplash
backsplash-tile.note: Kill power to outlets; use box extenders. Grout after mortar cures.

siding-lap.title: Lap / board-and-batten siding
machinery: Fiber-cement shears or circular saw w/ PCD blade
siding-lap.note: Overlap ~1-1/4 in., caulk butt joints, don't overdrive nails; follow the maker's nailing schedule.

siding-masonry.title: Brick / stone veneer
machinery: Angle grinder w/ diamond blade (or masonry wet saw)
siding-masonry.note: Professional install recommended - needs lath + scratch coat, correct flashing, dry weather above ~40F; heavy and mortar-dependent.

siding-stucco.title: Stucco
machinery: Drill + mortar mixing paddle (or mortar mixer)
siding-stucco.note: Professional install recommended - three-coat system (scratch, brown, finish ~7/8 in.), 24-48 hr moist cure between coats.

trim.title: Trim & moulding
trim.note: DIY-friendly (Intermediate). Cope inside corners, miter outside; nail into studs; caulk before paint.

door.title: Door
machinery: Circular saw or multi-tool (trim old jamb)
door.note: DIY-friendly; set plumb and level, shim behind each hinge and the strike, check reveal and swing before fastening.

garage-door.title: Garage door
garage-door.note: Professional install recommended - torsion/extension springs are under extreme tension and can cause serious injury; follow the maker's instructions.

roof-shingle.title: Asphalt shingle roof
roof-shingle.note: Professional install recommended. Nail in the printed zone (4-6 per shingle); ~3 bundles/square + 10-20% waste; follow maker + local code.

roof-metal.title: Standing-seam metal roof
roof-metal.note: Professional install recommended. Panels fasten with concealed clips (never face-screwed) to move with thermal expansion; confirm clip, seamer and min slope with the panel maker.

roof-tile.title: Clay / concrete tile roof
machinery: Angle grinder w/ diamond blade or tile saw
roof-tile.note: Professional install recommended. Underlayment + flashing do the waterproofing; heavy load - verify roof structure; follow TRI/FRSA high-wind + local code.

landscape-general.title: Landscaping
parts: Drip tubing, emitters, 25-30 PSI regulator + backflow
Artificial turf or sod + seaming tape + turf nails
landscape-general.note: DIY-friendly. Drip runs low pressure (~20-30 PSI) - use a regulator + filter; compact base in lifts; check local turf-removal/drip rebates.

faucet.title: Faucet / fixture
faucet.note: Shut off supply valves first; wrap threads 3x clockwise.

quiz.title: Find your style
quiz.intro: Four quick taps and we'll start you on a style — tweak anything after.
